RENAME OBJECT BUSC.CRM_CATEGORIES TO CRM_CATEGORIES_BU_20240416;

SELECT COUNT(1) cnt , 'bu_table' tables FROM busc.CRM_CATEGORIES_BU_20240416


---------------------------2
CREATE TABLE  [BUSC].[CRM_CATEGORIES]
( 
	[BANK_ID] [varchar](8)  NULL,
	[CATEGORYID] [numeric](38,0)  NULL,
	[CATEGORYTYPE] [varchar](30)  NULL,
	[VALUE] [varchar](200)  NULL,
	[DESCRIPTION] [varchar](200)  NULL,
	[DEL_FLG] [varchar](1)  NULL,
	[SCD_Start_Date] DATE,
	[SCD_End_Date] DATE,
	[isActive] [char]  NULL,
	[isLatest] [char]  NULL,
	[BNK_CODE] [varchar](20)  NULL,
	[SOURCE_CODE] [varchar](20)  NULL,
	[FILE_NAME] [varchar](100)  NULL,
	[insert_dttm] [datetime]  NULL
)
WITH
(
	DISTRIBUTION = HASH([CATEGORYID]),
	CLUSTERED COLUMNSTORE INDEX
)


---------------------------3

INSERT INTO [BUSC].[CRM_CATEGORIES]

SELECT 
 BANK_ID
,CATEGORYID
,CATEGORYTYPE
,[VALUE] 
,DESCRIPTION
,DEL_FLG
,CAST(LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME,12),8) AS DATE) SCD_START_DATE
,CAST('9999-12-31' AS DATE) SCD_END_DATE
,isActive
,1 isLatest
,BNK_CODE
,SOURCE_CODE
,FILE_NAME
,CAST(insert_dttm AS DATETIME2)
FROM (
SELECT *,
row_number() over ( partition by BANK_ID, CATEGORYID, CATEGORYTYPE, [value], DESCRIPTION order by LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME,12),8)) as seq_no
FROM [BUSC].[CRM_CATEGORIES_BU_20240416]
) as x
where seq_no = 1
